title: Skyson Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of Plaspak Group Limited's plastic packaging business.

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced.
ACCC announced that it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Skyson Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of Plaspak Group Limited's plastic packaging business.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC assessed the proposed acquisition under the narrowest possible markets, these being the national markets for the supply of non-beverage rigid plastic containers and plastic closures.
body_sections.Competition analysis: 1. Non-beverage rigid plastic containers The ACCC decided that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the national market for non-beverage rigid plastic containers. The ACCC found that there were low barriers to entry and expansion in the market for non-beverage rigid plastic containers. In particular, it appeared that there were low establishment costs for smaller suppliers and new entrants were able to access second-hand equipment to reduce costs. In addition, there was a high level of import competition. 2. Plastic Closures The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the national market for plastic closures because: (i)	market concentration would not change significantly; and (ii)	import levels were relatively high.
